title: Stage 48 — Off the Rails expansion
notes: Two new original multi-character comedy radio episodes. Synthesized voice demos. Existing linear broadcast, station introductions and every-two-program ad breaks preserved. No skip or shuffle controls added. Production build and browser playback unverified.

dialogue.speaker: glitch
dialogue.line: Welcome to Off the Rails, where the traffic is imaginary and the parking fines are painfully real.

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.line: Our first story. A dragon has received a parking ticket in Solara Desert. The ticketing officer has requested a transfer to somewhere less flammable.

dialogue.speaker: glitch
dialogue.line: What exactly counts as a parked dragon?

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.line: According to the city code, any winged vehicle that remains stationary for more than six minutes. There is no size exemption.

dialogue.speaker: caller
dialogue.line: Hello. I am calling from the desert. I was parked beside the dragon, and now my car is technically a shadow.

dialogue.speaker: glitch
dialogue.line: Did you try turning the dragon off and back on?

dialogue.speaker: caller
dialogue.line: I tried. The dragon turned me off and back on.

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.line: Please do not attempt to reboot wildlife. The operator handbook is very clear on this point.

dialogue.speaker: glitch
dialogue.line: Coming up next, our financial correspondent explains why dragon insurance costs more than a dragon.

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.line: We spoke to an insurance agent who says the premiums are based on fire risk and the likelihood of the policyholder being eaten.

dialogue.speaker: glitch
dialogue.line: So the discount is for customers who never make a claim.

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.line: The discount is for customers who never make it home.

dialogue.speaker: caller
dialogue.line: I would like to report that my windshield is now a decorative window in a volcano.

dialogue.speaker: glitch
dialogue.line: That is excellent resale value. Open plan living.

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.line: In other news, Nexus City installed a new smart traffic light. It has become self aware and is currently refusing to turn green.

dialogue.speaker: glitch
dialogue.line: Finally, a machine that understands how I feel on Monday.

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.line: The traffic light says it will resume service once drivers stop calling it a lamp.

dialogue.speaker: glitch
dialogue.line: This is Off the Rails. Keep both hands on the wheel and absolutely no dragons in the loading zone.

dialogue.speaker: glitch
dialogue.line: Good evening Operators. You are listening to Off the Rails, the only station broadcasting from a studio with an emergency portal under the desk.

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.line: Today we investigate rising rent in procedurally generated dungeons.

dialogue.speaker: glitch
dialogue.line: I rented a studio dungeon last month. Yesterday it added three rooms and a boss without telling me.

dialogue.speaker: caller
dialogue.line: I am a dungeon landlord. We provide premium amenities including mood lighting, free fog, and a skeleton concierge.

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.line: The concierge attacked a tenant.

dialogue.speaker: caller
dialogue.line: That is the welcome experience.

dialogue.speaker: glitch
dialogue.line: Does the dungeon have laundry facilities?

dialogue.speaker: caller
dialogue.line: There is a washing machine on floor seven. It is also a mimic.

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.line: Our consumer reporter has advised tenants not to put socks inside any furniture with teeth.

dialogue.speaker: glitch
dialogue.line: How about the security deposit?

dialogue.speaker: caller
dialogue.line: We return the deposit when the tenant defeats the final boss.

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.line: That sounds illegal.

dialogue.speaker: caller
dialogue.line: It is in the lease. Paragraph four hundred and two. Written in ancient runes.

dialogue.speaker: glitch
dialogue.line: I knew I should have asked for the translation.

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.line: A new survey finds ninety percent of Operators want affordable housing. The other ten percent are currently trapped behind a puzzle door.

dialogue.speaker: glitch
dialogue.line: We asked a developer why the stairwell keeps moving.

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.line: He said it is a dynamic floor plan and charged another fee.

dialogue.speaker: caller
dialogue.line: For a small monthly payment we can upgrade your dungeon to include a window.

dialogue.speaker: glitch
dialogue.line: What does the window look out on?

dialogue.speaker: caller
dialogue.line: Another dungeon.

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.line: Thank you for listening. Remember to read the lease before opening a treasure chest.

dialogue.speaker: glitch
dialogue.line: This is Off the Rails. Your security deposit has been converted to experience points.
